title: Antigamente no PxG x hoje
concept: Nostalgia split: a sepia 12 fps CRT TV shows the old grind (farmar mato na mão, perder shiny por 1 segundo, dormir na cadeira), the TV powers off and the screen snaps to crisp purple 'HOJE' (PC desligado, alarme no WhatsApp, char farmando enquanto você dorme), then a veteran customer's real line about the bot getting easier ('mamão com açúcar'), ending on the same TV with the logo.
claims: alarmes no celular e notificações no WhatsApp

notes: The concept used the veteran quote ('No começo não tinha / Nois ralava') as the punchline of 'Antigamente no PxG', but in the print (mamao-com-acucar, sender [cliente] per ASSETS.md) he talks about the KizuBot panel's early days. To keep it truthful the quote comes after HOJE, framed 'QUEM USA DESDE O COMEÇO:' and tagged 'print real de cliente · sobre o painel'. Item 1 is 'farmar mato na mão' (dropped 'até 4h' to avoid repeating 071). Old era = sepia 12 fps CRT TV with a generic login box (no game logo); the end card returns on the same TV for the loop. Brand cue added early: '@kizubotpxg' on the TV bezel from frame 0, and 'com KizuBot' + '100% AFK' chips under HOJE. Grid drift + slow push-in on the quote card so no stretch reads as frozen.
